# Feature coverage map: classic-UI client vs the original VB6 client

<!-- Generated by tools/coverage/build-map.mjs. Do not edit by hand; run `node tools/coverage/build-map.mjs`. -->

Sources of truth are code. VB6 packet ids and names: server `PacketId.bas` (PYMMO=0), cached in `tools/coverage/vb6-snapshot/`. Handlers come from the dispatcher `Select Case` of the receiving side (`Protocol.bas`). Forms: the 86 `frm*.frm`/`Menu*.frm` files of the classic client. Ours: `packages/protocol/src` and `tests/fixtures/vb6` on the scanned refs below (the checked-out commit by default; `--include-branches` adds every `origin/feat/*` branch).

A packet is **covered** when a codec is registered for it (`[Table.Name]:` in a codec table) on main or on an open branch. **merged** means on main. Fixture means a recorded VB6 frame for that id exists under `tests/fixtures/vb6` on some branch. Forms are covered only with evidence of a UI surface (file exists on the stated ref); a partial surface is shown as partial and not counted.

Scanned refs: `main`

## Headline

- **Packets covered (merged + open branches): 463 of 523 = 88.5%.** Merged on main only: 463 = 88.5%.
  - Server to client: 190 of 207. Client to server: 273 of 316. Packets with a recorded VB6 fixture: 237.
- **Forms covered: 4 of 86 = 4.7%** (5 more partially, 10.5% started).

## Next work packages

Disjoint by construction: every uncovered packet and form belongs to exactly one package (`tools/coverage/classify.mjs`). Packet ids are `S` = server to client, `C` = client to server. Start these on top of main. Build time for a package of this size is roughly 10 to 25 minutes of agent time each (our 26 Oct calibration); the wait column is review, merge order and a recorded fixture session.
